stories.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic is offering free security checks for computer code projects that are shared publicly online. The software will scan for problems and alert project owners if it finds anything dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use open-source software for your business, it may become safer. This mostly helps software developers though, not typical small business owners.

stories.title: California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches
stories.simple_summary: California's government stopped a company from hosting a fight between a human and a robot. The state says these events need permission just like regular sports events do.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect ordinary people or small businesses. It's mainly about entertainment regulations.

stories.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
stories.simple_summary: Three researchers who worked at OpenAI were fired. They say the company's reasons are not fair and worry it will make other workers afraid to speak up about safety problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and industry watchers. For everyday people, it raises questions about whether AI companies take safety seriously enough.

stories.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
stories.simple_summary: Actor Ben Affleck knows a lot about artificial intelligence technology. He even started a company that uses AI for making movies before selling it to Netflix.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect your business or daily life. It's just interesting that a celebrity understands AI well.

stories.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
stories.simple_summary: A company that ranks different AI systems raised a large amount of money from investors. The company is now worth 3.1 billion dollars.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's money earnings are much lower than people thought they would be. Instead of 70 billion dollars a year, the real number is much smaller.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to investors who own pieces of OpenAI. It suggests the AI business is slower to make money than some people hoped.

stories.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
stories.simple_summary: Google is updating its Gemini AI to do more tasks on its own and work with business software automatically. The AI can now handle multiple jobs at the same time like an employee would.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's business tools, your AI assistant might become more helpful by doing more work without you asking for each step.

stories.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic made new rules about how people can use its AI assistant Claude. The company now forbids using it for election fraud, weapons building, and extreme repeated mistreatment.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude for your business, you need to stay away from these forbidden uses. For most honest business owners, this won't change anything.

stories.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI created an AI system that solves math problems, but the solutions don't follow the rules that math experts set up. The work quality isn't meeting professional standards yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to researchers and mathematicians. Regular business owners don't need to worry about this.

stories.title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: USA Today newspaper is suing OpenAI in court. The paper says OpenAI copied hundreds of thousands of its articles without permission to train its AI, and wants over 250 million dollars as payment.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows ongoing legal fights over AI companies using published content. It may eventually affect what AI systems can do or how news companies get paid.

stories.title: SpaceXAI backs Omarchy, the controversial Linux distro, with $1.5 million in compute
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX is giving money and computer power to support a free software project called Omarchy. This mostly involves technology industry insiders working together.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect typical small business owners or everyday people.

stories.title: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic updated its rules to stop people from being cruel to its Claude AI for no good reason. The company also banned uses like election fraud, weapons building, and illegal spying.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude, you should follow these rules. For honest business use, nothing changes.
